title_en: Gan Lu v. Jinan University — dispute over decision of expulsion from school
ruling_gist_en: Students may file a lawsuit in accordance with the law against decisions made by institutions of higher education, such as expulsion, which seriously affect their right to education. When people's courts hear such cases, they shall take relevant laws and regulations as the basis, refer to relevant rules, and may also refer to the school rules and regulations officially published by the involved institution of higher education that do not violate the spirit of higher-level legal provisions.

full_text_en:
甘露不服暨南大学开除学籍决定案

Gan Lu v. Jinan University — dispute over expulsion decision

【裁判摘要】

Ruling Summary

学生对高等院校作出的开除学籍等严重影响其受教育权利的决定可以依法提起诉讼。人民法院审理此类案件时，应当以相关法律、法规为依据，参照相关规章，并可参考涉案高等院校正式公布的不违反上位法规定精神的校纪校规。

A student may lawfully file a lawsuit against a decision made by an institution of higher education that seriously affects his or her right to education, such as expulsion. When hearing such a case, a people's court shall base its judgment on relevant laws and regulations, take relevant rules as reference, and may also refer to the school rules and regulations officially published by the institution of higher education involved that do not contravene the spirit of superior laws.

最高人民法院行政判决书

Administrative Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

（2011）行提字第12号

(2011) Xing Ti Zi No. 12

申请再审人（一审原告、二审上诉人）甘露，女，1981年10月15日出生，汉族，住沈阳市东陵区南塔东街24号7-6-1。

Applicant for Retrial (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Gan Lu, female, born on October 15, 1981, Han ethnicity, residing at 7-6-1, 24 Nanta East Street, Dongling District, Shenyang.

委托代理人湛中乐，北京大学教授。

Agent ad litem: Zhan Zhongle, professor at Peking University.

委托代理人湛中卓，北京市众天律师事务所律师。

Agent ad litem: Zhan Zhongzhuo, lawyer at Beijing Zhongtian Law Firm.

被申请人（一审被告、二审被上诉人）暨南大学，住所地广州市天河区黄埔大道西601号。

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Jinan University, located at 601 West Huangpu Avenue, Tianhe District, Guangzhou.

法定代表人胡军，该校校长。

Legal representative: Hu Jun, President of the university.

委托代理人李伯桥，该校教师。

Agent ad litem: Li Boqiao, teacher at the university.

委托代理人陆宇星，广东胜伦律师事务所律师。

Agent ad litem: Lu Yuxing, lawyer at Guangdong Shenglun Law Firm.

申请再审人甘露因诉被申请人暨南大学开除学籍决定一案，不服广东省广州市中级人民法院（2007）穗中法行终字第709号行政判决和广东省高级人民法院（2010）粤高法行监字第6号驳回再审申请通知，向本院申请再审。本院经审查后认为原生效判决可能存在适用法律错误的情形，以（2010）行监字第1023号行政裁定提审本案。本案提审后，本院依法组成合议庭公开开庭审理了本案。甘露的委托代理人湛中乐、湛中卓，暨南大学的委托代理人李伯桥、陆宇星到庭参加了诉讼。本案现已审理终结。

The Applicant for Retrial, Gan Lu, filed an application for retrial with this Court challenging the administrative judgment of the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province (2007) Sui Zhong Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 709 and the notice rejecting the retrial application of the Guangdong High People's Court (2010) Yue Gao Fa Xing Jian Zi No. 6 in the case concerning the expulsion decision made by the Respondent, Jinan University. After review, this Court found that the effective original judgment may involve errors in the application of law, and thus decided to initiate a retrial of this case by administrative ruling (2010) Xing Jian Zi No. 1023. After the retrial was initiated, this Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and held a public hearing in this case. The agents ad litem of Gan Lu, Zhan Zhongle and Zhan Zhongzhuo, and the agents ad litem of Jinan University, Li Boqiao and Lu Yuxing, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. This case is now concluded.

广东省广州市中级人民法院（2007）穗中法行终字第709号终审判决认定以下事实:甘露原系暨南大学华文学院语言学及应用语言学专业2004级硕士研究生。2005年间，甘露在参加现代汉语语法专题科目的撰写课程论文考试时，提交了《关于“来着”的历时发展》的考试论文，任课老师发现其提供的考试论文是从互联网上抄袭，遂对其进行批评、教育后，要求重写论文。甘露第二次向任课老师提供的考试论文《浅议东北方言动词“造”》，又被任课老师发现与发表于《江汉大学学报》2002年第2期《东北方言动词“造”的语法及语义特征》一文雷同。2006年3月8日，暨南大学作出暨学〔2006〕7号《关于给予硕士研究生甘露开除学籍处理的决定》，给予甘露开除学籍的处分。甘露不服，向广东省教育厅提出申诉，广东省教育厅于2006年5月16日作出粤教法〔2006〕7号《学生申诉决定书》，认为暨南大学对甘露作出处分的程序违反《暨南大学学生违纪处分实施细则》第三十三条的规定，影响甘露的陈述权、申诉权及听证权的行使，不符合《普通高校学生管理规定》第五十五条、第五十六条的规定，责令暨南大学对甘露的违纪行为重新作出处理。暨南大学收到广东省教育厅的决定书后，于2006年6月1日将调查谈话通知单送达给甘露母亲赵小曼，并于当天就甘露违纪事件进行调查。2006年6月2日，暨南大学华文学院向暨南大学学生违纪处理委员会办公室建议给予甘露开除学籍的处分。6月6日，暨南大学研究生部向学校领导提交有关给予硕士研究生甘露开除学籍处理报告，建议对甘露作出开除学籍的处理。6月7日，暨南大学将违纪处理告知书送达给甘露母亲赵小曼，并制作了告知笔录。2006年6月13日，赵小曼将陈述、申辩材料交暨南大学。暨南大学也对甘露陈述申辩作了记录。2006年6月15日，暨南大学学生违纪处理委员会召开会议，决定给予甘露开除学籍的处分，并将给予甘露开除学籍处分的意见提交校长办公会议进行讨论。6月19日，暨南大学召开2006年第16次校长办公会议，会议决定同意给予甘露开除学籍的处分，并制作了暨学〔2006〕33号《关于给予硕士研究生甘露开除学籍处分的决定》（以下简称开除学籍决定），对甘露作出开除学籍处分。6月21日，暨南大学将处分决定送达给赵小曼。6月23日，暨南大学又通过特快专递EMS将开除学籍决定寄送给甘露。2007年6月11日，甘露以暨南大学作出的开除学籍决定没有法律依据及处罚太重为由，向广州市天河区人民法院提起行政诉讼，请求撤销暨南大学作出的开除学籍决定并承担案件诉讼费。广州市天河区人民法院以（2007）天法行初字第62号行政判决维持了开除学籍决定。甘露不服提起上诉。

The final judgment of the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province (2007) Sui Zhong Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 709 found the following facts: Gan Lu was originally a master's degree candidate in the class of 2004, majoring in Linguistics and Applied Linguistics at the College of Chinese Language and Culture of Jinan University. In 2005, while taking the course examination for the subject of Special Topics in Modern Chinese Grammar, which was in the form of writing a course paper, Gan Lu submitted an examination paper titled "On the Diachronic Development of 'Lai Zhe'". The course instructor discovered that the submitted paper was plagiarized from the Internet and thus criticized and educated her, then required her to rewrite the paper. The second examination paper submitted by Gan Lu to the course instructor, titled "A Brief Discussion on the Verb 'Zao' in Northeast Dialects," was also found by the course instructor to be identical to an article titled "Grammatical and Semantic Features of the Verb 'Zao' in Northeast Dialects" published in the 2nd issue of the *Journal of Jianghan University* in 2002. On March 8, 2006, Jinan University issued Ji Xue [2006] No. 7, "Decision on Expelling Master's Degree Candidate Gan Lu," imposing the sanction of expulsion on Gan Lu. Dissatisfied, Gan Lu filed an appeal with the Education Department of Guangdong Province. On May 16, 2006, the Education Department of Guangdong Province issued Yue Jiao Fa [2006] No. 7, "Student Appeal Decision Letter," holding that the procedure by which Jinan University imposed the sanction on Gan Lu violated Article 33 of the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of Student Disciplinary Sanctions of Jinan University," affecting the exercise of Gan Lu's rights to statement, appeal, and hearing, and did not comply with Articles 55 and 56 of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education," and ordered Jinan University to re-process Gan Lu's disciplinary violation. After receiving the decision letter from the Education Department of Guangdong Province, Jinan University delivered a notice of investigation interview to Gan Lu's mother, Zhao Xiaoman, on June 1, 2006, and conducted an investigation into Gan Lu's disciplinary violation on the same day. On June 2, 2006, the College of Chinese Language and Culture of Jinan University recommended to the Office of the Student Disciplinary Committee of Jinan University that Gan Lu be expelled. On June 6, the Graduate School of Jinan University submitted to the university leadership a report on handling the expulsion of master's degree candidate Gan Lu, recommending expulsion. On June 7, Jinan University delivered a notice of disciplinary sanction to Zhao Xiaoman and made a record of the notification. On June 13, 2006, Zhao Xiaoman submitted materials of statement and defense to Jinan University. Jinan University also recorded Gan Lu's statement and defense. On June 15, 2006, the Student Disciplinary Committee of Jinan University held a meeting and decided to impose the sanction of expulsion on Gan Lu, and submitted the opinion of expelling Gan Lu to the President's Office Meeting for discussion. On June 19, Jinan University held the 16th President's Office Meeting of 2006, which decided to approve the expulsion of Gan Lu, and issued Ji Xue [2006] No. 33, "Decision on Expelling Master's Degree Candidate Gan Lu" (hereinafter referred to as the Expulsion Decision), imposing the sanction of expulsion on Gan Lu. On June 21, Jinan University served the disciplinary decision on Zhao Xiaoman. On June 23, Jinan University further sent the Expulsion Decision to Gan Lu by express mail (EMS). On June 11, 2007, Gan Lu filed an administrative lawsuit with the Tianhe District People's Court of Guangzhou, arguing that the Expulsion Decision made by Jinan University lacked legal basis and was too severe, requesting the revocation of the Expulsion Decision and that Jinan University bear the litigation costs. The Tianhe District People's Court upheld the Expulsion Decision by administrative judgment (2007) Tian Fa Xing Chu Zi No. 62. Gan Lu disagreed and appealed.

广东省广州市中级人民法院终审判决认为，根据《中华人民共和国教育法》的规定，暨南大学有权对受教育者进行学籍管理，实施奖励或者处分。《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十四条第（五）项规定，剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果，情节严重的，学校可以给予开除学籍处分。第六十八条规定，高等学校应当根据本规定制定或修改学校的学生管理规定，报主管教育行政部门备案，并及时向学生公布。《暨南大学学生管理暂行规定》第五十三条第（五）项、原《暨南大学学生违纪处分实施细则》第二十五条规定，剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果，情节严重的，可给予开除学籍处分。本案中，甘露两次抄袭他人论文作为自己的考试论文，其行为属于抄袭他人研究成果，在任课老师已经指出其错误行为后，甘露仍然再次抄袭欺骗老师，这种治学态度是很不严谨的。暨南大学认为甘露违规行为属情节严重，主要证据充分，甘露认为其行为属考试作弊的理由不成立，不予采纳。在学校处理过程中甘露书面表达了自己的意见，也委托母亲接受了暨南大学的调查、进行了申辩，暨南大学处理程序并未影响甘露行使法定权利，甘露认为开除学籍决定程序违法的主张缺乏依据，不予支持。在适用法律方面，暨南大学根据法律授权制定了本校的学生管理规定，并依照该规定对甘露作出开除学籍决定，并无违反法律、法规和规章规定。需要指出的是，在《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十四条已对开除学籍情形作出规定的情况下，暨南大学在开除学籍决定中没有引用该规定不妥，但该瑕疵不足以影响开除学籍决定的合法性。综上，广东省广州市中级人民法院认为，广州市天河区人民法院（2007）天法行初字第62号行政判决维持暨南大学的开除学籍决定正确。因此，广东省广州市中级人民法院判决驳回甘露上诉，维持原判。

The final judgment of the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court held that, in accordance with the provisions of the Education Law of the PRC, Jinan University has the authority to manage the academic status of recipients of education and to impose rewards or sanctions. Article 54(5) of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education" stipulates that if a student plagiarizes or copies the research results of others, and the circumstances are serious, the school may impose the sanction of expulsion. Article 68 stipulates that institutions of higher education shall formulate or revise their student administration regulations based on these Regulations, report them to the competent administrative department of education for record, and promptly publicize them to students. Article 53(5) of the "Interim Provisions on Student Administration of Jinan University" and Article 25 of the original "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of Student Disciplinary Sanctions of Jinan University" stipulate that if a student plagiarizes or copies the research results of others, and the circumstances are serious, the sanction of expulsion may be imposed. In this case, Gan Lu plagiarized others' papers twice as her own examination papers. Her conduct constituted copying the research results of others. After the course instructor had already pointed out her wrongful conduct, Gan Lu again plagiarized and deceived the teacher. Such an academic attitude is very unrigorous. Jinan University considered that Gan Lu's disciplinary violation was serious in circumstances, and the main evidence was sufficient. Gan Lu's argument that her conduct constituted examination cheating was untenable and was not adopted. During the university's handling process, Gan Lu expressed her opinion in writing and also entrusted her mother to accept the investigation by Jinan University and to present a defense. The handling procedure of Jinan University did not affect Gan Lu's exercise of legal rights. Gan Lu's claim that the procedure of the Expulsion Decision was illegal lacked basis and was not supported. In terms of the application of law, Jinan University formulated its student administration regulations based on legal authorization and made the Expulsion Decision against Gan Lu in accordance with those regulations, which did not violate laws, regulations, or rules. It should be noted that, although Article 54 of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education" has provided for the circumstances of expulsion, it was inappropriate that Jinan University did not cite that provision in the Expulsion Decision. However, this defect was insufficient to affect the legality of the Expulsion Decision. In summary, the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court held that the administrative judgment of the Tianhe District People's Court (2007) Tian Fa Xing Chu Zi No. 62, which upheld the Expulsion Decision of Jinan University, was correct. Therefore, the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court rejected Gan Lu's appeal and affirmed the original judgment.

后甘露向广东省高级人民法院申请再审，该院以（2010）粤高法行监字第6号驳回再审申请通知驳回其再审申请。

Thereafter, Gan Lu applied for a retrial with the Guangdong High People's Court, which rejected her application by notice (2010) Yue Gao Fa Xing Jian Zi No. 6.

甘露向我院申请再审称:其作为暨南大学2004级硕士研究生在修读学位课程现代汉语语法专题时，先后两次上交的课程论文存在抄袭现象属实。但该课程考试形式是以撰写课程论文方式进行的开卷考试，抄袭他人论文的行为违反了考试纪律，应按违反考试纪律的规定给予处分。但这种抄袭行为并不是《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十四条第（五）项和《暨南大学学生管理暂行规定》第五十三条第（五）项规定所称的“剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果”的违纪行为。暨南大学适用《暨南大学学生管理暂行规定》第五十三条第（五）项规定给予开除学籍处分认定事实不清、适用法律不当、处分程序不合法，且处分明显偏重。请求本院撤销原审判决并撤销开除学籍决定，责令暨南大学重新作出具体行政行为或者直接将开除学籍决定变更为其他适当的处分，同时赔偿因诉讼多年而支出的交通住宿等直接支出费用89601元和因丧失学习机会造成的间接损失及精神赔偿100000元。

In her application for retrial to this Court, Gan Lu argued: As a master's degree candidate of the class of 2004 at Jinan University, she did indeed plagiarize in the two course papers she submitted successively for the degree course Special Topics in Modern Chinese Grammar. However, the examination format for this course was an open-book exam in the form of writing a course paper. The act of copying others' papers violated examination discipline and should be sanctioned according to the provisions on violating examination discipline. However, this act of plagiarism did not constitute the disciplinary violation of "plagiarizing or copying the research results of others" as referred to in Article 54(5) of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education" and Article 53(5) of the "Interim Provisions on Student Administration of Jinan University." Jinan University, by applying Article 53(5) of the "Interim Provisions on Student Administration of Jinan University" to impose expulsion, had unclear findings of fact, improper application of law, illegal sanction procedure, and the sanction was clearly too severe. She requested this Court to revoke the original judgment and the Expulsion Decision, order Jinan University to re-make a specific administrative act or directly change the Expulsion Decision to another appropriate sanction, and simultaneously compensate her for direct expenses of RMB 89,601 incurred over years of litigation, such as transportation and accommodation, as well as indirect losses from the loss of learning opportunities and moral compensation of RMB 100,000.

暨南大学答辩称：学期课程论文作为研究生修读课程的考试形式之一，也是研究生在学习期间研究成果的一部分，研究生理应严格认真对待。甘露连续两次的抄袭行为已经严重违反了《高等学校学生行为准则》、《普通高等学校学生管理规定》以及《暨南大学学生管理暂行规定》，丧失了作为一名学生所应有的道德品质，应按照《暨南大学学生违纪处分实施细则》进行处理。即便如申请人所述，其行为属于考试作弊行为，而根据《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十四条第（四）项的规定:“由他人代替考试、替他人参加考试、组织作弊、使用通讯设备作弊及其他作弊行为严重的”，仍然可以给予申请人开除学籍处分。因此，开除学籍决定认定事实清楚、定性准确，适用法律正确。请求本院依法维持原审判决，并驳回甘露在原一、二审期间未曾提出的赔偿请求。

Jinan University responded: Semester course papers, as one form of examination for graduate students' courses, are also part of the research results of graduate students during their studies. Graduate students should treat them strictly and seriously. Gan Lu's consecutive two acts of plagiarism have seriously violated the "Code of Conduct for Students in Institutions of Higher Education," the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education," and the "Interim Provisions on Student Administration of Jinan University," and she has lost the moral character that a student should possess. This should be handled in accordance with the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of Student Disciplinary Sanctions of Jinan University." Even if, as the applicant claims, her conduct constituted examination cheating, according to Article 54(4) of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education," which provides: "having others take an examination in one's place, taking an examination in place of others, organizing cheating, using communication devices to cheat, and other serious cheating behaviors," the applicant could still be expelled. Therefore, the Expulsion Decision had clear findings of fact, accurate characterization, and correct application of law. Jinan University requested this Court to uphold the original judgment in accordance with the law and to reject the compensation claims that Gan Lu had not raised during the original first and second instances.

本院庭审中，双方当事人对原生效判决所认定的事实均无异议，本院经审查后依法予以确认。

During the hearing of this Court, both parties had no objection to the facts found by the effective original judgment. After review, this Court confirmed them in accordance with the law.

本院在复查期间和提审后，曾先后多次组织双方当事人进行协调。但暨南大学坚持不自行撤销开除学籍决定，而甘露则坚持在暨南大学不自行撤销开除学籍决定情况下，不接受任何形式的经济补偿或者赔偿，因而双方未能达成和解。庭审后，甘露再次向本院书面说明，因已经失去5年最好的光阴，其已不愿意回到学校修完学业。

During the review period and after the retrial, this Court organized mediation between the parties on several occasions. However, Jinan University insisted on not voluntarily revoking the Expulsion Decision, while Gan Lu insisted on not accepting any form of economic compensation or damages unless Jinan University voluntarily revoked the Expulsion Decision. Therefore, the parties failed to reach a settlement. After the hearing, Gan Lu again submitted a written statement to this Court, stating that having already lost the best five years of her life, she was no longer willing to return to the university to complete her studies.

本院认为，高等学校学生应当遵守《高等学校学生行为准则》、《普通高等学校学生管理规定》，并遵守高等学校依法制定的校纪校规。学生在考试或者撰写论文过程中存在的抄袭行为应当受到处理，高等学校也有权依法给予相应的处分。但高等学校对学生的处分应遵守《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十五条规定，做到程序正当、证据充足、依据明确、定性准确、处分恰当。特别是在对违纪学生作出开除学籍等直接影响受教育权的处分时，应当坚持处分与教育相结合原则，做到育人为本、罚当其责，并使违纪学生得到公平对待。违纪学生针对高等学校作出的开除学籍等严重影响其受教育权利的处分决定提起诉讼的，人民法院应当予以受理。人民法院在审理此类案件时，应依据法律法规、参照规章，并可参考高等学校不违反上位法且已经正式公布的校纪校规。

This Court holds: Students in institutions of higher education shall comply with the "Code of Conduct for Students in Institutions of Higher Education," the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education," and the school rules and regulations lawfully formulated by institutions of higher education. Plagiarism by students during examinations or in the process of writing papers shall be dealt with, and institutions of higher education have the right to impose corresponding sanctions in accordance with the law. However, when imposing sanctions on students, institutions of higher education shall comply with Article 55 of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education," ensuring that the procedure is proper, the evidence is sufficient, the basis is clear, the characterization is accurate, and the sanction is appropriate. Particularly when imposing sanctions that directly affect the right to education, such as expulsion on a student who violates discipline, the principle of combining sanctions with education shall be adhered to, with education as the foundation, punishment commensurate with the fault, and the student treated fairly. If a student who violates discipline files a lawsuit against a sanction decision, such as expulsion, made by an institution of higher education that seriously affects his or her right to education, the people's court shall accept the case. When hearing such a case, the people's court shall base its judgment on laws and regulations, take rules as reference, and may also refer to the school rules and regulations of the institution of higher education that do not contravene superior laws and have been officially published.

《暨南大学学生管理暂行规定》第五十三条第（五）项规定，剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果，情节严重的，可给予开除学籍处分。《暨南大学学生违纪处分实施细则》第二十五条规定，剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果，视情节轻重，给予留校察看或开除学籍处分。暨南大学的上述规定系依据《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十四条第（五）项的规定制定，因此不能违背《普通高等学校学生管理规定》相应条文的立法本意。《普通高等学校学生管理规定》第五十四条列举了七种可以给予学生开除学籍处分的情形，其中第（四）项和第（五）项分别列举了因考试违纪可以开除学籍和因剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果可以开除学生学籍的情形，并对相应的违纪情节作了明确规定。其中第（五）项所称的“剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果”，系指高等学校学生在毕业论文、学位论文或者公开发表的学术文章、著作，以及所承担科研课题的研究成果中，存在剽窃、抄袭他人研究成果的情形。所谓“情节严重”，系指剽窃、抄袭行为具有非法使用他人研究成果数量多、在全部成果中所占的地位重要、比例大，手段恶劣，或者社会影响大、对学校声誉造成不良影响等情形。甘露作为在校研究生提交课程论文，属于课程考核的一种形式，即使其中存在抄袭行为，也不属于该项规定的情形。因此，暨南大学开除学籍决定援引《暨南大学学生管理暂行规定》第五十三条第（五）项和《暨南大学学生违纪处分实施细则》第二十五条规定，属于适用法律错误，应予撤销。一、二审法院判决维持显属不当，应予纠正。鉴于开除学籍决定已生效并已实际执行，甘露已离校多年且目前已无意返校继续学习，撤销开除学籍决定已无实际意义，但该开除学籍决定的违法性仍应予以确认。甘露在本院再审期间提出的其在原审期间未提出的赔偿请求，本院依法不予审查。

Article 53(5) of the "Interim Provisions on Student Administration of Jinan University" provides that if a student plagiarizes or copies the research results of others, and the circumstances are serious, the sanction of expulsion may be imposed. Article 25 of the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of Student Disciplinary Sanctions of Jinan University" provides that plagiarism or copying of others' research results shall, depending on the seriousness of the circumstances, result in disciplinary probation or expulsion. The above provisions of Jinan University were formulated based on Article 54(5) of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education," and therefore cannot contravene the legislative intent of the corresponding provision of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education." Article 54 of the "Regulations on the Administration of Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Education" lists seven situations in which a student may be expelled, with subparagraphs (4) and (5) respectively listing situations where expulsion may be imposed for violating examination discipline and for plagiarizing or copying the research results of others, and clearly stipulates the corresponding disciplinary circumstances. The term "plagiarizing or copying the research results of others" in subparagraph (5) refers to situations where a student in an institution of higher education plagiarizes or copies the research results of others in a graduation thesis, degree thesis, or publicly published academic articles, works, or in the research results of a scientific research project undertaken by the student. The term "serious circumstances" refers to situations where the act of plagiarism involves illegally using a large quantity of others' research results, where the plagiarized portion occupies an important position or a large proportion of the total results, where the means are vile, or where the social impact is significant, causing adverse effects on the school's reputation, among others. Gan Lu, as a current graduate student, submitted course papers, which is a form of course assessment. Even if there was plagiarism, it does not fall within the circumstances specified in that provision. Therefore, the Expulsion Decision of Jinan University, which invoked Article 53(5) of the "Interim Provisions on Student Administration of Jinan University" and Article 25 of the "Detailed Rules for the Implementation of Student Disciplinary Sanctions of Jinan University," constituted an error in the application of law and should be revoked. The judgments of the first and second instance courts upholding the decision were clearly improper and should be corrected. Considering that the Expulsion Decision has taken effect and been actually implemented, that Gan Lu has been away from the university for many years and currently has no intention to return to the university to continue her studies, revoking the Expulsion Decision would have no practical significance. However, the illegality of the Expulsion Decision should still be confirmed. As for the compensation claims raised by Gan Lu during the retrial that were not raised during the original proceedings, this Court will not review them in accordance with the law.

综上，依据《中华人民共和国行政诉讼法》第六十一条第（二）项和最高人民法院《关于执行〈中华人民共和国行政诉讼法〉若干问题的解释》第五十七条第二款第（二）项的规定，判决如下:

In summary, in accordance with Article 61(2) of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC and Article 57(2)(2) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC, the judgment is as follows:

一、撤销广东省广州市中级人民法院（2007）穗中法行终字第709号行政判决和广州市天河区人民法院（2007）天法行初字第62号行政判决；

1. Revoke the administrative judgment of the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province (2007) Sui Zhong Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 709 and the administrative judgment of the Tianhe District People's Court of Guangzhou (2007) Tian Fa Xing Chu Zi No. 62;

二、确认暨南大学暨学〔2006〕33号《关于给予硕士研究生甘露开除学籍处分的决定》违法。

2. Confirm that the "Decision on Expelling Master's Degree Candidate Gan Lu" (Ji Xue [2006] No. 33) of Jinan University is illegal.

一、二审案件受理费共计人民币100元，由被申请人暨南大学负担。

The total case acceptance fee for the first and second instances is RMB 100, to be borne by the Respondent, Jinan University.

本判决为终审判决。

This judgment is final.
